Subject: Post-call recap + request: org map & approval pathway for ThunderGrid pilot

Hi Lara —

Great to meet today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we have a clean path to pilot kickoff:  

1) Scope: 8-week sandbox for internal agent routing (approx. 2M tokens/mo).
2) Success criteria: 90th pctl latency < 300ms for 512-token responses; cost target < $0.002/token using batching + 4-bit quantized model.
3) Security gating: you mentioned a brief security questionnaire and a SOC2 cert review.

Would you share a simple org map (names/titles) for the stakeholders who own:
- Economic approval (budget owner)
- Security/compliance contact for evidence intake (SOC2/pen tests)
- Legal/procurement contact who handles MSAs and SOWs

If it helps, I attached a one-pager recap and the meeting recording link. Next steps I propose:
- You share the org contacts by Thurs 4/18
- We schedule a 30-min legal/procurement intro with Ben to walk through standard terms (propose Fri 4/19)
- Security sends the questionnaire to jordan.blake@redwood.com (we’ll turn around evidence in 2–3 business days)

Attachments: [attachment: thundergrid-postcall-recap.pdf (PDF)] [attachment: redwood-demo-recording-20280415.mp4 (link)]

Appreciate the quick turnaround — let me know if that timeline is realistic.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0143

Thanks Mina — good recap and very helpful. Quick answers here:  

Economic owner: Samir Patel (Head of Business Ops) — I looped him on this thread for visibility.
Security/compliance intake: Daphne Ruiz (Security Program Manager) — she owns evidence intake and will be our point for questionnaires.
Procurement/legal: Our contracts team is centralized; Samir owns vendor approval and Becky Lee (contracts@thundergrid.com) will handle the MSA/SOW redlines.

Daphne, I can share the security questionnaire and a couple sample policies. We usually require an internal review turn-around of up to 7 business days. Is that an acceptable expectation for Redwood?

2) Daphne — can you share the security questionnaire (or a short list of most critical items) and a preferred S3/SharePoint upload location for evidence? Jordan will run the intake and can provide the SOC2 mapping we typically send.
